desc:
🚗 Start your own car company in 2009 and grow it into a global automaker!

🛠️ DESIGN every detail: pick a body, engine, drivetrain, chassis, paint, wheels and interior, then crash test and test drive your car.
🏭 BUILD it in your factory: set the price, add assembly lines and robots, and watch the sales roll in.
🔬 RESEARCH 130+ technologies from petrol engines to hydrogen and flying-car tech.
👥 HIRE designers, engineers and salespeople, and grow from a tiny workshop to a huge HQ.
🏁 RACE in GT, Formula, rally and drag racing to win fans, sponsors and trophies.
📈 BEAT rival carmakers, show your cars at motor shows and become a billion-dollar company!

🎁 Join the Sunset Entertainment group for a free reward.
👋 Invite friends to get a big gift for each friend who joins.

Thumbs up and favorite for more updates!
